title: 第11章 健肌壮骨汤第12章 冲突
content_zh:
第一一章 健肌壮骨汤
天灵大陆的药物，都蕴含着灵力，只是多少不同、属性有别而已。灵药堂一楼的药物只经过粗浅的加工处理，没有炼制，药力较弱，领取回去后，或生嚼，或熬成药汤服用，都可以。
所有的药物都分门别类，或增强体质、或淬炼脏腑、或增加灵力，不一而足。聂空在药架前走过，看着木箱上面的药物名称，眉头越皱越紧。
这些药物，他基本上都没听过，只有少数几种有点印象，可对它们的药性全然不知。当然，这也怪不得身体的原主人，他那时没有进入灵药堂的资格，一般都是在外面购买炼制过的成品灵药，平时又沉迷修炼，对这些东西没时间也没机会去了解。而且，入这灵药堂取药的少年，来前家里长辈都会细细叮嘱要找哪种药，像聂空这样一个人冒冒失失就跑来的，绝无仅有。
难不成今天要空手而归？
聂空暗暗苦笑，只有经过合理的搭配，才能将药物中蕴含的药力最大限度地发挥出来，然而现在不知药性，如果胡乱挑几样增强体质的回去吃了，效果虽有，却绝不会太好，甚至连他一成的要求都可能达不到。
“咦，天心子？”
走到第五排药架前时，看到其中一个木箱上的药名，聂空心头一跳，终于碰到种熟悉的药物了。
可惜这药物是“妖魔”中的。
在玩游戏时，聂空选择的生活职业便是炼药，对里面的药物熟稔之极。像这“天心子”便是其中一种，可以用来炼制低阶药水“健肌壮骨汤”，服用后可让玩家瞬间增加一百点的体质，持续半个小时。在妖魔里，一点体质代表的是四点血量，所以这健肌壮骨汤对低级玩家还是不错的。
这里毕竟不是游戏，不知这种“天心子”是怎样的？
聂空心中竟有点忐忑，深吸口气，全部都是颗粒状的药物，形状大小类似米粒，表层红彤彤的。聂空捻起一粒放在掌中细细观看，很快便发现它表层的纹路形状都与妖魔游戏中的“天心子”一模一样。
“太好了。”
聂空精神大振，抓起一把药物放在旁边的白纸上包裹起来，然后继续搜寻药箱。虽说还不知道游戏里的“健肌壮骨汤”放到现实中能不能起到作用，可聂空现在两眼一抹黑，试试总是可以的，即便是不能达到增强体质的效果，也不会损害身体，反正这里的药草都能直接服用。
须蝴蝶草！水晶玉莲子！
走完大半药架时，聂空又找到“健肌壮骨汤”配方中的两种药，最后还剩下一种“赤魔花”。在此期间，聂空又看到过数十种在妖魔游戏里出现的药物，只不过聂空现在还用不到它们。
环视一周，聂空把目光投向最后两排，那里分别醒目地标示着“微毒”、“剧毒”，显然都是些蕴含毒性的药物。
聂空走到那排“微毒”的药架前。
“赤魔花！”
第三个箱子的药名进入视线，聂空如释重负地暗松口气，这次他以的，只要药物不超五种、总量不超一斤就行。

抓着四包药来到门侧的秃顶老头跟前。
老头依旧是副半死不活的样子，捏着小药包从鼻下横过，不断报出名称重量：“天心子，二两……须蝴蝶草，二两……水晶玉莲子，二两……”
老头终于抬起眼皮，目光中有点讶异，显然是没想到聂空抓药这么准，他却不知这是聂空前世经过二十多年才锻炼出来的。微微顿了一顿，抓起最后一包药，念道：“赤魔花，四两。”
说出赤魔花三字时，老头又看了聂空一眼，却没有多说什么，放下药包后，又开始昏昏欲睡。
聂空微一躬身，拿起药包和族牌出了大门，和聂青锋打过招呼后，匆匆向家里赶去，他有些迫不及待了。
厨房内，聂空盘坐在装满热水的大木桶里，身上扎着九枚金针，面庞在腾腾雾气中若隐若现。花眉则蹲在门口的小药炉前，小手轻挥蒲扇，时不时回头看看，腮帮子红馥馥的，有些羞怯。
“嫂嫂，可以倒药了。”
聂空的声音响起，花眉忙提起炉上药罐，走到桶前，双颊红晕更盛。羞涩地垂下眼帘，花眉玉手用力，滚烫的药汁冲出罐嘴，源源注入桶中，嫣红如血，顷刻间便将整桶水染得通红。
这剂药加入天心子一两，须蝴蝶草一两，水晶玉莲子一两，赤魔花二两。聂空带回来的药物可以煎熬两次。
此刻，聂空浑身皮肤已被热水烫得绯红。
药汁倒入时，聂空快速揉捻天针的指头一颤，窍穴随之剧烈震动，灵力如水纹般向四周扩散，全身三万六千个毛孔瞬即张开，缕缕红色药汁顿时如活物一般，顺着毛孔从四面八方钻入聂空体内。
金针急速震颤，健肌壮骨汤的药力点点滴滴地渗入肌肉和骨骼中。木桶中的热水颜色渐渐变淡，通过散布全身的灵力，聂空甚至可以清晰感觉到自己萎缩的肌肉在缓慢膨胀，疏松的骨骼在不断坚硬。
健肌壮骨汤果然有奇效！
聂空心中振奋，像天心子、徐蝴蝶草和水晶玉莲子这三种药物要是直接分别吃下，部分药力最终会转化成灵力，部分药力还没发挥出来就已消散，至于增强体质只是顺带的，效果微弱。可它们与赤魔花煎成“健肌壮骨汤”后，药力既没有转化成灵力，也没有浪费，几乎全部被聂空的肌肉和骨骼吸收。
天灵大陆的灵药，基本上都与修炼有关，灵力几乎可以包治百病。一旦遇到聂空这种灵力无效的情况，便一筹莫展。这里并没有“对症下药”的说法，就如聂空前身十几年来所服用的药物，全都可以用在灵力修炼上。它们的药力如今附贴在经脉中，非常庞大，若是聂空自己吸收，体质的确会逐渐增强，可更多的药力最终还是会转化成灵力，绝不会像“健肌壮骨汤”这样疗效显著。
对症下药四字，并不只是随便说说的。
过了大约半小时，残余的一丝药力被吸收入体后，被药汁染红的水恢复了清澈。这时，木桶里已没有多少热度，聂空并未起身，继续震动金针，将药力化散开来，让它们与身体更加紧密相融。
又是半个小时过去，水桶完全变凉，聂空双目睁开，眉开眼笑地将身上九枚金针取出，搁放在灶台上。
“好，好，好个健肌壮骨汤！”
聂空满意地呵呵直笑，在自己身上捏来捏去，胸脯、双腿，以及手臂等部位的肌肉微微鼓起，两肋处的骨骼痕迹也不再那么明显，低头在水中一照，凹陷的眼眶和双颊都变得丰润了许多。

现在的聂空，再也看不出一小时前那骨瘦如柴的样子。
——————————————————————————————————————————————
花眉在外面等得有些焦灼，终于见到聂空的身影走出厨房，整个人都变得呆滞起来，红唇微张，眼眸溜圆，神色间满是难以置信。
“嫂嫂。”
看到花眉目瞪口呆的模样，聂空不由一笑。
“你……你是叔叔？”
花眉讷讷的说道，目光来来回回地在聂空身上挪移，脸上的难以置信渐渐被惊喜和激动替代，娇声道，“真的是叔叔，你真的是叔叔，这么快就变壮了。”眉梢间都荡漾着掩饰不住的笑意。
见花眉喜难自抑，聂空也禁不住笑吟吟道：“嫂嫂，三天后再泡一次那种药汤，我就能跟正常人差不多了。”第二次吸收“健肌壮骨汤”的效果肯定远不如这次，但对聂空来说足够了。
“嗯嗯。”
花眉绕着聂空转来转去，兴奋得连连点头，像是在观赏着稀罕的宝物。这几天的事情，对花眉来说就像是做梦一样，先是聂空死而复生吓走武童等人，接着用那九根金针给自己治病，然后十年没有进展的修为突然提升到聚灵三品，现在又因那“健肌壮骨汤”而变得健壮起来。
真是太神奇了！
如果不是和聂空相处了三年，又是眼睁睁看着聂空苏醒的，她都会以为自己的叔叔已经换了个人。现在好了，终于不用再担心聂空会突然撑不住而病逝，花眉心底变得异常轻松起来。
花眉欢快的笑容，让聂空心中充满了温馨，这么一个好女孩，绝不能让聂风行那混蛋得逞。如果说刚醒来那天聂空还有点担忧的话，现在的他已毫不畏惧，既然妖魔游戏里的药剂有效，一个“健肌壮骨汤”的配方完全比得上一瓶“回春露”了。这“健肌壮骨汤”对通灵以上的灵师无大用，可对聚灵，尤其是刚刚接触到灵力修炼的孩童来说，绝对是种不可多得的灵药。

Chapter 1 Muscle and Bone Strengthening Soup
The medicines in Tianling Continent all contain spiritual power, but they are just different in quantity and properties. The medicines on the first floor of the Spiritual Medicine Hall have only been roughly processed, not refined, and have weak potency. After receiving them, they can be chewed raw or made into medicinal soup for consumption.
All medicines are divided into categories, such as strengthening the body, refining the internal organs, or increasing spiritual power. Nie Kong walked by the medicine shelf and frowned more and more as he looked at the names of the medicines on the wooden box.
He had basically never heard of these medicines, only a few of them had some impression, but he had no idea about their medicinal properties. Of course, this is no wonder the original owner of the body. He was not qualified to enter the elixir hall at that time. He usually bought refined elixirs from outside. He was also addicted to cultivation and had no time or opportunity to understand these things. Moreover, the elders of the family will carefully tell the young man who goes to this elixir hall to get medicine before he comes, which kind of medicine he is looking for. It is unique for a man like Nie Kong to come here recklessly.
Is it possible that we are going to leave empty-handed today?
Nie Kong secretly smiled bitterly. Only through reasonable combination can the power contained in the medicine be brought out to the maximum extent. However, now that we don’t know the properties of the medicine, if we randomly pick a few things to enhance our physical fitness and eat them, although the effect will be there, it will never be very good, and it may not even meet his 10% requirement.
"Hey, Tian Xinzi?"
When he walked to the fifth row of medicine shelves, he saw the name of the medicine on one of the wooden boxes. Nie Kong's heart skipped a beat and he finally came across a familiar medicine.
It's a pity that this medicine is from the "demon".
While playing the game, Nie Kong's career choice was refining medicine, and he was extremely familiar with the medicines in it. This "Tianxinzi" is one of them, which can be used to refine the low-level potion "Muscle Strengthening Bone Soup". After taking it, the player can instantly increase his physical fitness by a hundred points and last for half an hour. In Monster, one point of constitution represents four points of health, so this muscle-building and bone-strengthening soup is good for low-level players.
After all, this is not a game. I wonder what this kind of "Tianxinzi" is like?
Nie Kong felt a little uneasy and took a deep breath. They were all granular drugs, similar in shape and size to rice grains, with a red surface. Nie Kong picked one up and put it in his palm to look at it carefully. He soon discovered that the texture and shape on its surface were exactly the same as the "Tianxinzi" in the monster game.
"Great."
Nie Kong became energetic, grabbed a handful of medicines, wrapped them in white paper next to him, and then continued to search the medicine box. Although I still don’t know if the “Muscle Strengthening and Bone Strengthening Soup” in the game can work in reality, Nie Kong’s eyes are dark now. It is always possible to try it. Even if it cannot achieve the effect of strengthening the body, it will not harm the body. Anyway, the herbs here can be taken directly.
Butterfly grass! Crystal jade lotus seeds!
After walking through most of the medicine shelves, Nie Kong found two more medicines in the "Muscle Strengthening Bone Soup" formula, and finally there was one "Red Devil Flower" left. During this period, Nie Kong saw dozens of drugs that appeared in the monster game, but Nie Kong could not use them yet.
After looking around, Nie Kong turned his attention to the last two rows, where "slightly toxic" and "highly toxic" were clearly marked respectively. They were obviously poisonous drugs.
Nie Kong walked to the row of "slightly poisonous" medicine shelves.
"Red Devil Flower!"
The names of the medicines in the third box came into view, and Nie Kong secretly breathed a sigh of relief. This time, he thought, as long as there were no more than five types of medicines and the total amount did not exceed one kilogram.
Grabbing four packets of medicine, he came to the bald old man by the door.
The old man still looked half-dead, holding the small medicine bag under his nose, and kept reporting the name and weight: "Tianxinzi, two liang... Butterfly grass, two liang... Crystal Jade Lotus seed, two liang..."
The old man finally raised his eyelids with a bit of surprise in his eyes. Apparently he didn't expect Nie Kong to be so accurate in taking the medicine, but he didn't know that this was Nie Kong's past life experience.It took more than twenty years of training. After a slight pause, he grabbed the last packet of medicine and said, "Red Devil Flower, four taels."
When he said the words "Red Devil Flower", the old man glanced at Nie Kong again, but didn't say anything more. After putting down the medicine bag, he began to fall asleep again.
Nie Kong bowed slightly, picked up the medicine bag and clan tag and walked out of the door. After greeting Nie Qingfeng, he hurried home. He couldn't wait.
In the kitchen, Nie Kong sat cross-legged in a large wooden bucket filled with hot water, with nine golden needles stuck in his body, his face looming in the steaming mist. Huamei squatted in front of the small medicine stove at the door, waving the cattail fan lightly with her little hand, looking back from time to time, her cheeks were red and she was a little shy.
"Sister-in-law, you can pour the medicine."
Nie Kong's voice sounded, and Huamei hurriedly picked up the medicine jar on the stove and walked to the bucket, her cheeks flushed even more. Lowering her eyes shyly, she exerted force with her pretty hands, and the hot concoction rushed out of the mouth of the jar and poured into the bucket. It was as red as blood and dyed the entire bucket of water red in an instant.
To this medicine, add one ounce of Tianxinzi, one ounce of Butterfly Grass, one ounce of Crystal Jade Lotus Seed, and two ounces of Red Devil Flower. The medicine Nie Kong brought back can be used for two times.
At this moment, Nie Kong's skin was turned crimson by the hot water.
When the concoction was poured in, Nie Kong's fingers that quickly kneaded the Heavenly Needle trembled, and the acupoints vibrated violently. The spiritual power spread around like water ripples. The 36,000 pores in his body opened instantly, and wisps of red concoction suddenly penetrated Nie Kong's body from all directions along the pores like living things.
The golden needles trembled rapidly, and the medicinal power of the muscle-building and bone-building soup seeped into the muscles and bones bit by bit. The color of the hot water in the barrel gradually faded. By spreading the spiritual power throughout his body, Nie Kong could even clearly feel that his atrophied muscles were slowly expanding and his loose bones were becoming harder.
Muscle and bone strengthening soup really works wonders!
Nie Kong was excited. If these three medicines, such as Tianxinzi, Xu Butterfly Grass and Crystal Jade Lotus Seeds, were taken separately, part of the medicine's power would eventually be converted into spiritual power, and part of the medicine's power would have dissipated before it was exerted. As for the enhancement of physical fitness, it would only be incidental and the effect would be weak. But after they were boiled with red devil flowers to form a "muscle-strengthening and bone-strengthening soup", the medicinal power was neither converted into spiritual power nor wasted. Almost all of it was absorbed by Nie Kong's muscles and bones.
The elixirs in Tianling Continent are basically related to cultivation, and spiritual power can cure almost all diseases. Once encountering a situation like Nie Kong's spiritual power is ineffective, there is nothing he can do. There is no such thing as "prescribing the right medicine to the case". Just like the medicines Nie Kong's predecessor took for more than ten years, they can all be used for spiritual cultivation. Their medicinal power is now attached to the meridians and is very large. If Nie Kong absorbs it by himself, his physique will indeed gradually strengthen, but more of the medicinal power will eventually be converted into spiritual power, and it will never be as effective as "Strengthening Muscles and Strengthening Bones".
The four words "prescribe the right medicine" are not just mentioned casually.
About half an hour later, after the remaining trace of medicinal power was absorbed into the body, the water stained red by the medicinal juice returned to clarity. At this time, there was not much heat in the barrel, and Nie Kong did not stand up. He continued to vibrate the golden needles to disperse the medicinal power and integrate them more closely with the body.
Another half hour passed and the bucket became completely cold. Nie Kong opened his eyes and took out the nine golden needles from his body with a smile on his face and placed them on the stove.
"Okay, okay, what a muscle and bone strengthening soup!"
Nie Kong laughed with satisfaction and pinched himself. The muscles in his chest, legs, and arms bulged slightly, and the bone marks on his ribs were no longer so obvious. When he lowered his head and looked into the water, his sunken eye sockets and cheeks became much plumper.
Nie Kong now no longer looks like the scrawny person he was an hour ago.
————————————————————————————————————————————
Huamei was a little anxious waiting outside, and finally saw Nie Kong's figure leaving.When he left the kitchen, his whole body became dull, his red lips were slightly opened, his eyes were round, and his expression was full of disbelief.
"Sister-in-law."
Seeing Huamei's dumbfounded look, Nie Kong couldn't help but smile.
"You...you are uncle?"
The flowery eyebrows said calmly, her eyes moving back and forth on Nie Kong. The disbelief on her face was gradually replaced by surprise and excitement, and she said softly, "I am really an uncle. You are really an uncle. You have grown so strong so quickly." There was a smile on the eyebrows that could not be concealed.
Seeing Huamei's joy, Nie Kong couldn't help but smile and said: "Sister-in-law, take that medicinal soup again in three days, and I will be almost like a normal person." The effect of absorbing the "Muscle Strengthening Bone Soup" for the second time is definitely not as good as this time, but it is enough for Nie Kong.
"Yeah."
Huamei walked around Nie Kong, nodding excitedly, as if admiring a rare treasure. The events of the past few days were like a dream to Huamei. First, Nie Kong came back from the dead to scare Wu Tong and others away, and then used the nine golden needles to treat his illness. Then his cultivation level, which had not made any progress for ten years, was suddenly promoted to the third level of Juling. Now he became strong again because of the "muscle and bone soup".
It's so amazing!
If she hadn't spent three years with Nie Kong and watched Nie Kong wake up, she would have thought that her uncle had changed. Now that she is fine, she no longer has to worry about Nie Kong suddenly being unable to hold on and dying of illness, Huamei feels extremely relaxed.
Huamei's cheerful smile filled Nie Kong's heart with warmth. Such a good girl would never let that bastard Nie Fengxing succeed. If Nie Kong was a little worried the day he first woke up, he was no longer afraid now. Since the potions in the demon game were effective, the formula of "Muscle Strengthening Bone Soup" was completely comparable to a bottle of "Rejuvenation Dew". This "muscle-strengthening and bone-strengthening soup" is of little use to spiritual masters who are psychic or above, but it is definitely a rare elixir for gathering spirits, especially children who have just come into contact with spiritual power cultivation.
